name: Vapour pressure deficit
formula_or_method: FAO-56 average saturation vapour pressure, e_a derived from dew point
limitation: Approximation from daily dew point, not hourly VPD or exact daily mean

name: FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration
dependencies: T2M T2M_MIN T2M_MAX T2MDEW WS2M PS ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN latitud
limitation: Estimated from daily radiation and elevation inferred from surface pressure; not directly observed ET₀

name: Crop evapotranspiration
limitation: Without planting/growth-stage data: average-Kc scenario only, not measured ETc

name: Growing degree days
limitation: No implica conocer ciclo o fecha de siembra

name: Rainfall since January 1
limitation: If a day is missing, the cumulative series is null from that day onward

name: Thermal reference crossing
formula_or_method: Daily comparison against reference; actual growth stage unknown
limitation: Visual warning; not proof of damage

name: P - ETc de escenario
limitation: Not actual water stress: irrigation and storage data are missing

name: Volumetric root-zone moisture
limitation: Do not infer water stress from m³/m³ without field capacity

name: Vegetation index
limitation: Ausente sin paso libre de nubes; no diario interpolado

name: Vegetation moisture index
limitation: Does not measure soil moisture; unlike SMAP, native B11 is 20 m

name: Crop water depletion
dependencies: RZMC capacidad de campo punto marchitez profundidad riego etapa
formula_or_method: Root-zone water balance and total available water (TAW)
limitation: Field soil texture, field capacity/wilting point, irrigation and growth stages unavailable

name: Mechanical damage
limitation: Mean WS2M is not a gust speed or damage threshold
